summary: Identify downstream obligations and evidence needed to change a system safely.

inputs.name: change-set
inputs.description: Candidate, changed interfaces, data, configuration, and behavioral claims.

inputs.name: project-context
inputs.description: Relevant system boundaries, consumers, and verification paths.

completion_checks: Consequential direct and indirect consumers are identified.
Safety claims have evidence or explicit pending checks.
Rollout, compatibility, and recovery obligations are recorded.
failure_modes: A consequential boundary cannot be inspected: blocked for that assessment.
Safety depends on an unresolved assumption: inconclusive.
The candidate demonstrably violates an existing obligation: failed.
